newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products up, mogas up $4, fuel barges up $1.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products up, mogas up $4, fuel barges up $1.

text.p: NWE oil products were firmer across the barrel on Friday morning.

Gasoline gained $2 as Eurograde barges traded at $215 fob ARA and regular at $204. Crack spreads against Brent were also firmer. Naphtha was firmer as the three-day Skikda closure delayed at least two cargoes, boosting barge demand.
Gas oil rose $4.25 on futures but barge premiums softened slightly and cargo premiums were talked around 50 cents lower.
Fuel consolidated recent gains with high sulphur barges up $1. Dealers estimate 250,000 tonnes of fuel was sold to the U.S. this week. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 5387
